findings.description: _run_hold_loop ships with `if True:`, so LOCAL PENDING runs return without ever entering HOLD.
The backend=None guard sits at the top of run(), killing the heuristic/disabled/static-rule paths that never need an LLM.
The except clause around receipt loading is too narrow, missing ValueError and RecursionError, so other read failures escape.
The backend=None early return leaves the previous run's last_surfaces behind, so daemon_state would inject stale surfaces into its prompt.
The cite-reverify regex makes the '[+ N] ' annotation prefix optional, weakening the test; production always annotates.
